div.div: Stable SSRC lets the add-on's rtp-source run sess.ignore-ssrc = false — it latches onto this one sender and rejects any other box on the same port (anti-interleave). Older firmware used a random per-boot SSRC, which forced ignore-ssrc = true (accept-any). Codec is effectively SBC-only on the ESP32.

div.div:
Alternative implementation:
a Raspberry Pi (BlueZ + PipeWire,
no custom firmware) feeds the SAME
add-on rtp-source, with real aptX/AAC
codecs — see firmware/pi-bridge
and decisions.md.
